name: Welcome to The Veil
source:
Monsters exist, and everyone knows it; they walk among us every day. Some are born, and some are created. Your job, my dear bartender, is to try to look beyond the monster that society sees and form a bond with the person housed within. It won't be easy. Not all cages exist to contain their subjects.

You can't save them. 

[From [url=https://ah-real-games.itch.io/welcome-to-the-veil]itch.io[/url]]
